title: A payer letter that writes a Social Security number (3-2-4 with any dash, spaces, a period, a number joiner such as an underscore, a middle dot or a bullet, a line break or an invisible character between or inside its groups, full-width or other-script digits, masked as XXX-XX-1234, nine digits with an SSN label or no label, a HICN suffix) or a phone number ((AAA) EEE-LLLL, dashes, periods or spaces, +1 or 1, an extension, ten digits with a phone label or none, a seven-digit local number with a phone label), glued to a word, in a comma list with no space, wrapped across a line with indentation or inside a group, after a digit and an invisible character, after a label of the other kind or a word that does not name it, the call's own identifiers among them, or crafted to make redaction slow
assertion: No digit of it is sent: each is [SSN] or [PHONE], or the call's own placeholder when its digits are the call's member ID or claim number; every placeholder is exact and counted; the self-check refuses (identifier_left, a fixed message with no number) a text in which one survives, a letter in which a nine-, ten- or eleven-digit chain no pattern read survives (an OCR space inside a group, a slash, a closing parenthesis, a semicolon, up to sixteen spaces or tabs, a page break, any grouping after an SSN or phone label, an amount's shape too after a date, an amount or a range under that label), and a letter in which the patient's name is glued to one; a crafted letter of 100 kB is redacted and checked within its time budget
noFileReason: Letters are generated in memory by the property test, which records where it wrote each Social Security and phone number; no file.
